correctness.rationale: After translating the parallelogram center to the origin, opposite-vertex subtraction forces every circumellipse to be centered there. In the basis of the two half-diagonals, every normalized positive-definite form is exactly \(K_c=\begin{pmatrix}1&c\\c&1\end{pmatrix}\) with \(|c|<1\). Determinants give the area ratio, the generalized eigenvalues are \(1\pm c\), and \(\delta=\operatorname{artanh}|c|\) gives the \(\cosh\) identity. The stability bound is the elementary inequality \(\sinh t\ge t\), and the coefficient is forced by the second-order limit at \(\delta=0\). A standalone checker independently replays the algebra under random affine changes of coordinates.
